brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full is the only part placed, no neighbours or upper levels added

requirements.requirement: Nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build contains only the base; no covers, caps, inserts or additional bases

Configurator offers no drawer socket on a full base (find_sockets drawer = 0). Drawers are only offered on the cut face of a half base (e.g. half-n gives 1 drawer socket s9), and at most one per base. Five drawers inside one base without adding cells is refused by the configurator's placement rules

finish.summary: Restored to single full hex base as requested. Five drawers inside a single base is not placeable: the configurator only allows drawers on half bases (one per cut face) and offers zero drawer sockets on a full base. Requirement for five drawers cannot be met without violating the \"nothing beside or on top\" constraint.

outcomes.message: dryRun is for addProp, moveProp and plant; other ops answer in the same time by being applied and undone.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
